verdict.rationale: Veriff is an API product, so issuing scoped credentials is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows only a shared secret key used for HMAC signing, allowed IP lists, and separate test integrations. These are adjacent security and environment controls. None of them documents issuing API credentials with restricted permissions or least-privilege scopes for an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
